fact: In a communique made public on 10 October 2024 the AMRTP lifted for six months the suspension of import and sale of Starlink kits, requiring Starlink and its partners to register with the AMRTP, equipment to be homologated and users to be identified.
title: Mali : L’AMRTP annonce la levée temporaire de la suspension des Kits Starlink pour six mois
